sections.h2: Why Ocala owners hand us the whole list
body: Ocala properties tend to carry more than one kind of surface. A home in the historic district around Tuscawilla can have wood porch columns, layered trim paint, and interior walls with years of patches on the same lot. An equestrian estate in SW Ocala may add a barn, board fencing, and a deck off the back of the main house. Hiring a separate trade for each piece means separate schedules and separate warranties.

Our painting services in Ocala, FL are built to avoid that. One crew lead walks everything, writes one itemized estimate, and stays the point of contact until you sign the final punch list. We use our own crews and never subcontract.

sections.h2: Match the service to the property
body: Different corners of Ocala call for different combinations. These are the pairings we write most often:
bullets: Historic Downtown and Tuscawilla homes: exterior repainting with careful scraping and spot-priming, plus trim and door work
Bellechase, Country Club of Ocala, and other association communities: whole-home repaints in an approved palette, often with a color consultation first
Horse properties in NW and SW Ocala: fence staining, deck restoration, and outbuilding coatings alongside the residence
Storefronts, offices, and multi-family buildings: commercial painting scheduled around business hours
Kitchens anywhere in town: cabinet refinishing paired with a fresh coat on the surrounding walls

body: Because the estimate is line-item, a large property can be split by priority. A common Ocala approach is to wash and paint the most sun-exposed elevations in the cooler months, then move to interiors or cabinets during summer, when exterior windows are shorter. Our article on exterior care in North Central Florida explains how to plan maintenance across seasons.
Nothing is added to the scope later without your written approval, so phasing never turns into surprise charges.

sections.h2: The product system behind every service
body: We use premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore lines and name the exact product on the estimate. Siding and trim get 100% acrylic, stucco with hairline movement gets elastomeric, cabinets, doors, and railings get waterborne urethane enamel, and exposed wood gets penetrating stain. Two full coats is the baseline, and a third goes on for dramatic color changes or porous surfaces. Low-VOC options are available for occupied homes and businesses.

sections.h2: Timing for a multi-service Ocala project
body: Walkthroughs are usually scheduled within 48 hours, and the written quote typically arrives within one business day. Work generally begins one to three weeks after approval. A single interior room is usually a one-day job, a full exterior runs three to seven working days plus washing and dry time, and combined scopes are sequenced so washing happens before painting and staining happens on dry wood. Start with our Ocala service area page to see how we work locally, or browse the full list of services.

faqs.q: Can you paint the house and stain the fence on my Ocala horse property in one project?
faqs.a: Yes. We write both on the same estimate, wash first, and schedule the staining once the wood is dry enough to take penetrating stain. One crew lead coordinates both.

faqs.q: Do I get one warranty for a combined scope?
faqs.a: Yes. Everything is backed by our written workmanship warranty, up to 10 years on exterior work, on top of the manufacturer's product warranty, with one company name on it.

faqs.q: Do you publish prices for painting services in Ocala?
faqs.a: No. Price depends on measured area, surface condition and prep, product line, access and height, and the number of colors, so we quote each property in writing after a free walkthrough.
